{
  "name": "game-earcons",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Earcons",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "8-bit sound cues on macOS, Windows and Linux: a permission prompt or question waiting on you, a long turn finished, an error, a guard refusing a call, a save",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-earcons",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "sound",
    "notifications"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off is silent; casual plays ask, block, save, errors and turns of minTurnSeconds or longer; hardcore adds every turn, failed tool calls and file changes",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "volume": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Volume",
      "description": "0 to 1",
      "default": 0.6,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1
    },
    "minTurnSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Done cue after (seconds)",
      "description": "In casual, a finished turn plays the done cue only when it took at least this long",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600
    }
  }
}
